wordCoverage.note: Answers are automated. These are actual requests and distinct recorded words for this input policy, not natural human coverage or learning evidence. Effective casts are deduplicated by question ID; main-route impacts exclude healing, optional guards and return-only enemies. Death/retry may still repeat an encounter. Raw impact events can include multiple hits per cast.

renderBudget.note: Production birth counters and allocated transient objects; camera fixtures are not used in this route.

browserFrameCadence.note: Host browser rAF intervals during play, not an engine FPS or device compatibility guarantee.

scope: Local automated checks only. Isolated suites may arrange initial positions and observe protected AI. Whole routes use real keyboard input and production state, with automated answers. These results do not establish human fun, natural vocabulary coverage, learning efficacy, play duration, low-end performance or remote CI success. Hashes identify files at export; report dates retain their actual execution times.
